From e2521b2a8baabdaf43b92192588f51e042d21e97 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Steve Rowe <sarowe@apache.org>
Date: Fri, 28 Apr 2017 15:36:50 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] SOLR-9596: Add Solr support for SimpleTextCodec, via
 <codecFactory class=solr.SimpleTextCodecFactory/> in solrconfig.xml
 (per-field specification in the schema is not possible).


diff --git a/dev-tools/idea/solr/core/src/java/solr-core.iml b/dev-tools/idea/solr/core/src/java/solr-core.iml
index 6cf1ab175f4..61387b980d7 100644
--- a/dev-tools/idea/solr/core/src/java/solr-core.iml
+++ b/dev-tools/idea/solr/core/src/java/solr-core.iml
@@ -32,5 +32,6 @@
     <orderEntry type="module" module-name="join" />
     <orderEntry type="module" module-name="sandbox" />
     <orderEntry type="module" module-name="backward-codecs" />
+    <orderEntry type="module" module-name="codecs" />
   </component>
 </module>

diff --git a/solr/CHANGES.txt b/solr/CHANGES.txt
index 8f1fe870254..81288d8eee2 100644
--- a/solr/CHANGES.txt
+++ b/solr/CHANGES.txt
@@ -196,6 +196,9 @@ New Features
 
 * SOLR-10521: introducing sort=childfield(field) asc for searching by {!parent} (Mikhail Khludnev) 
 
+* SOLR-9596: Add Solr support for SimpleTextCodec, via <codecFactory class="solr.SimpleTextCodecFactory"/>
+  in solrconfig.xml (per-field specification in the schema is not possible). (Steve Rowe)
+
 Optimizations
 ----------------------

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `dev-tools/idea/solr/core/src/java/solr-core.iml`**
   - An additional module entry for `codecs` was added to the project configuration. This change allows the project to recognize and include the `codecs` module, which is likely necessary for the new SimpleTextCodec functionality.

2. **File: `solr/CHANGES.txt`**
   - A new entry was added to document the feature introduced by the patch. It states that Solr now supports `SimpleTextCodec` through the configuration of `<codecFactory class="solr.SimpleTextCodecFactory"/>` in `solrconfig.xml`. It also notes that per-field specification in the schema is not possible for this codec.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `solr-core.iml` establishes the necessary project structure to support the new `SimpleTextCodec` feature by including the `codecs` module. The entry in `CHANGES.txt` documents this new feature, providing users with information about the addition of `SimpleTextCodec` and how to configure it. Together, these changes ensure that the new codec functionality is integrated into the Solr project and communicated to users.
